summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash keeps its Engram tables in RAM by default
compatibility: The container needs about 190 GiB of host memory at TP4. On hosts with less, set ENGRAM_TABLE_MEMORY=disk.
details: Disk-resident Engram tables made decode speed depend on the page cache: repeated identical DS4.1 runs differed by up to 70%. RAM tables remove that dependency.
Disk tables still need --security-opt seccomp=unconfined and --ulimit memlock=-1 for io_uring; the configurator adds them.
